notes.detail: Wall banners on the stall backs, stools, stacked hay, pumpkins and crates at the sides, flower pots at the corners, flower beds by the cross.
notes.roof: Same flat wool awnings as L2.
notes.life: Flower beds, potted plants, lanterns and banners: busy and lived in.

visual.summary: Level 3 dresses the market for a busy day: flower beds round the cross, red and white banners on the stall backs, stall stools and goods stacked along the sides, potted plants at the corners.
problems: Minor: the four flower beds are single raised coarse_dirt cubes on the paving at (5,1,5), (9,1,5), (5,1,9), (9,1,9); they read as lumps of dirt. Sink them into the paving (replace the cobblestone at y 0) or rim them with trapdoors.
Note only: meta.groundLayer 0, the paving replaces the grass.
Reachability: 280 of 282 standing places reached; only the two cross-step tops at (6,6,7) and (8,6,7) are not, which is fine.

notes.roof: The automatic overhang warning is a false alarm: the stepped spruce pyramid over the cross overhangs its stone posts by one block all round and is finished with a lantern; the stall awnings are flat by design.
notes.levels: Clearly different from L2 at a glance: the cross is now a covered market cross with a dark pyramid roof that dominates the centre (top and front views), red-white banners on the stall backs, and goods stacks (pumpkins, hay, crates) at the outer corners. Answers Carlton's v1 note.

visual.summary: L2 plus a covered market cross with a stepped spruce pyramid roof, banners on the stall backs, stools and goods stacked at the corners: the finished market.
problems: Minor: the four new flower pots stand alone on the border bricks at (5,1,0), (13,1,0), (1,1,14), (9,1,14) and read a little stray; group them with the goods stacks or drop them.
Reachability: 306 of 330 standing places reached; only the top of the cross's pyramid roof (y 6..7) is not, which is fine.
